question: The Matrice 4T ASRS report proves it lost its link and crashed. What should it have done according to the manual?

intake.focus: lost link / control signal loss procedures (failsafe)
intake.reason: ASRS report indicates signal loss; request what the manual prescribes for aircraft action

brief.short_answer: The DJI Matrice 4T incident report found in the collection does not describe a lost link, so it is not used as evidence. According to the manual, when the RC signal is lost and the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH. It will start RTH using Advanced RTH per the RTH settings and will remain in RTH even if the RC link is later restored. If lighting and environment are unsuitable for the vision system, it will brake and hover, then enter Original Route RTH.
